notes: Locate phase. Styling: plain CSS custom properties in styles.css :root (light) and a prefers-color-scheme: dark block (styles.css:47-69); no component library; markup in five static HTML pages, dynamic markup rendered by string templates in app.js. Locations found by reading source (method code-read); element locations are where the element is rendered, root-cause entries point at the rule or handler to change. Shared roots: dark --color-ink-muted (COL-14 x5), dark --color-ok/--color-ok-tint (F-0001/2/33/121), .card__name a ellipsis (F-0009/10/14/47/122/145), .results minmax(330px) (F-0012/13/19/46/117/139), fixed .actionbar with 8 px page padding (F-0008/11/15/16/25/48/95/104/109), finder DOM/CSS order (F-0024/45/56/57/72/119/146), .sessions row-reverse/wrap-reverse (F-0028/77/92/113/125/143/144), Tab-trapping listbox keydown (F-0026/35). I saw the names of the workspace .eval directory and PRODUCT.md/DESIGN.md in a directory listing but did not open them.
